onboarding.title: Welcome to Reveric
onboarding.welcome: Let's set up your writing assistant
onboarding.language_description: Select your preferred interface language. You can change this later in settings.
onboarding.ai_provider_description: Add your own AI provider, or skip this step and configure one later in settings.
onboarding.user_profile_description: Set your display name and avatar to personalize Reveric.
onboarding.brand_tagline: Your AI writing companion — capture ideas and create with intent.
onboarding.profile_card_subtitle: Just two steps to start your writing journey
onboarding.theme_description: Select your preferred theme and appearance mode. You can change this later in settings.
onboarding.model_defaults_description: Set default AI models for different tasks. You can change this later in settings.
onboarding.guide.providers.list_body: Popular AI providers are prelisted here. Each item shows its supported capabilities (chat, image, video, audio) and an active status dot on the right.
onboarding.guide.providers.add_body: Use this button to add OpenAI-compatible relays, third-party endpoints, or installed plugin providers.
onboarding.guide.providers.credentials_b: Fixed official endpoints are prefilled. Enter your API Key here once you have one—if not, feel free to skip ahead and explore first.
onboarding.guide.providers.models_title: Configure Chat, Image, Video & Audio Models
onboarding.guide.providers.models_body: Chat models power writing and agents, image models power covers/characters/canvas images, and video/audio models power storyboards and voiceovers. Fetch models automatically or add model IDs manually; you can combine multiple providers.
onboarding.guide.providers.enable_title: Enable When Ready, Then Pick Defaults
onboarding.guide.providers.enable_body: Once your API Key and at least one model are set, toggle the switch in the top right to activate it. Then head to Model Settings to choose default models.
onboarding.guide.providers.mobile_detail: Tap any provider to enter its API Key and configure chat, image, video, and audio models. No key yet? You can skip for now and enable it anytime later.
onboarding.guide.providers.mobile_models: After enabling a provider, visit Model Settings to pick default chat and image models as well as models for built-in writing agents.
onboarding.guide.model_settings.chat_bod: Used by default for chat, outlining, and writing novels or screenplays. Supported models also let you tune reasoning effort.
onboarding.guide.model_settings.image_bo: Used by default in Cover Studio, character portraits, maps, and canvas image generation.
onboarding.guide.model_settings.agents_b: Assign dedicated models or custom prompts for built-in specialists (writer, review, polish, explorer, chronicler). Leave empty to follow the default chat model.
onboarding.guide.home.novel_body: Your workspace for novels and stories. Let AI help outline plots, draft chapters, and organize characters and worldbuilding.
onboarding.guide.home.screenplay_body: Organize seasons, episodes, scenes, and dialogue—and collaborate with AI on episode breakdowns and storyboards.
onboarding.guide.home.canvas_body: An infinite visual canvas connecting text, image, video, and audio nodes for storyboard and short-film creation.
onboarding.guide.home.models_body: Set up API keys and chat, image, video, and audio models here, then pick defaults in Model Settings. No key yet? You can explore first.
onboarding.guide.home.mobile_screenplay_: Organize seasons, episodes, scenes, and dialogue with AI assistance. Full visual canvas production is available on desktop.
onboarding.guide.home.mobile_assistant_b: Start AI chats, switch agents, and jump straight to Model Settings to configure defaults.
onboarding.guide.home.mobile_settings_bo: Go to Settings → AI Providers to configure API keys and chat, image, video, and audio models.
